purpose: Prove that expanded bounded banked storage preserves a one-to-one logical-index mapping across writers, readers and boundary transitions before native IR-v2 qualification.

mapping.mapping_rule: subtract complete preceding bank capacities; the first bank whose remaining index is below its capacity owns the slot

writer_reader_invariants: writer and reader use the same logical-index mapping
writing one logical index changes exactly one physical slot
reading the same logical index returns exactly the written full-width value
writing an index must not alias any other valid logical index
bank transition at each cumulative capacity boundary is exact
first and last slot of every bank are explicitly tested
invalid writes do not mutate storage
invalid reads fail closed rather than returning a neighboring slot
full signed i64 payloads are preserved where the physical lane is i64
capacity changes invalidate previous roundtrip proof and require regeneration
boundary_set: first slot of each bank after bank 0

relation_dependency.rule: If writer/reader dispatch is generated through relational trees, the relation-safe dispatch proof must pass first.

native_rule: Hosted/model roundtrip proof is necessary but not sufficient. The exact transformed Stage1 candidate must still pass native trivial/self-source/audit gates.
prohibited: assuming equal bank sizes when a tail bank is shorter
using modulo by the first-bank size without proving layout equivalence
writer/reader private mappings with no differential proof
treating aggregate count equality as proof of slot-level preservation
